Hi Camila,

I filled out the demo request from your pricing page this morning — FluxPay is evaluating hosted inference options and we have budget scoped for Q4. We did a quick self-serve sign-up and ran a couple of evaluation queries, but would like a short walkthrough of how Redwood handles multi-tenant routing, pricing predictability, and private deployment options.

High-level: we are a payments orchestration platform (12M ARR, growing) and care most about latency/SLOs for authorization paths and predictable unit economics.

Can you share availability next week (Mon–Thu mornings PST)? I included Alex (engineering lead) on this thread. I attached a short list of questions we hit while exploring the pricing page.

Thanks,
Jordan

Head of Infrastructure
FluxPay

Hi Jordan — great to meet you and thanks for the context.

Quick answers up front: Redwood supports private deployments (VPC/on-prem) and our routing layer can pin critical paths to a dedicated pool to meet latency SLOs. We also provide token-level cost breakdowns in the Console which most infra teams use to estimate unit economics. I attached our one-pager to give a concise view.

For a walkthrough, I can do:
- Tue 8/31 at 10:00 AM PT
- Wed 9/1 at 9:00 AM PT

If neither works, Marissa (cc'd) can send a calendar invite with more slots — she's our SDR who will coordinate the demo logistics and who will join as well to cover pricing and next steps.

Agenda proposal (20–30min):
1) 5m intros + goals
2) 10–15m product walkthrough: routing, dedicated pools, private deploy options
3) 5–10m pricing + procurement runway / next steps

Could you confirm which slot you prefer and whether Alex wants any specific deep-dive (e.g., KV cache, quantization profiles)?

Best,
Camila Reyes
